description_zh: 调用ModifyDedicatedHostClass接口升配主机的规格
kebab_example: aliyun cddc modify-dedicated-host-class --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dedicated-host-id ch-bp1fgj3kt7fsb0000 --target-class-code rds.c6.x4large --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDedicatedHostClass

parameters.help_en: The host ID. You can log on to the ApsaraDB for MyBase console and go to the Hosts page to view the host ID
parameters.help_zh: 主机ID。您可以登录云数据库专属集群控制台，在主机列表查看并获取主机ID
parameters.name: dedicated_host_id

parameters.help_en: The instance type to which you want the host to be upgraded. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206343.html
parameters.help_zh: 主机升配的规格编码，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206343.html
parameters.name: target_class_code

parameters.help_en:
The time when you want to upgrade the specifications of the host. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

This parameter must be specified only when SwitchTimeMode is set to 2
parameters.help_zh:
指定主机规格的升配时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
仅当SwitchTimeMode为2时，需要传入SwitchTime参数
parameters.name: switch_time

parameters.help_en:
The execution mode that is used to upgrade host specifications. Valid values:

0 (default): immediately upgrades host specifications.
2: upgrades host specifications at a specified point in time.

If you set this parameter to 2, you must specify SwitchTime
parameters.help_zh:
选择升配的执行模式，取值：
0（默认）：立刻执行升配。

2：在指定时间执行升配。

若本参数的值为2，则必须同时传入SwitchTime参数
parameters.name: switch_time_mode
